lead.name: Sara
lead.trait: Thinks like the buyer, prices like the seller.

title: CSV to QBO
oneLiner: Turn any bank or card CSV into a QBO, QFX or OFX file for QuickBooks in the browser, nothing uploaded
customer: US bookkeepers and small business owners importing bank history into QuickBooks
revenueModel: Monthly subscription in USD after a free first file

evidence.claim: DocuClipper sells CSV to QBO conversion from $29 a month for 60 pages.
ProperSoft sells its CSV2QBO converter with plans from $19.99 a month.
A QuickBooks community user asks for a CSV to QBO converter, saying the independent ones are not very good; a reply points to a $60 converter.

nextAction: Research. Against: Statement Extract already offers a CSV to QBO converter that it describes as free forever with unlimited files (https://statementextract.pages.dev/convert/csv-to-qbo/), so the search results already hold free clones and distribution is crowded.
